title: Symbolic link created in a shared directory (c)
description: The code creates a symbolic link with symlink. Between the check that the name is free and the creation another process can take the name, which turns a replace step into a write through an attacker-chosen link. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer checks the directory permissions.
remediation: Create links only in a directory the service alone can write, or use an exclusive primitive, for example symlinkat inside a private directory.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches link creation without inspecting directory permissions.
